summary: The note introduces Canadian Bioinformatics Workshops (CBW), a series of advanced bioinformatics training workshops. It states that CBW was founded in 1999 to address an identified need for a skilled bioinformatics workforce in Canada. The note is very brief and gives no further details on format, organizers, or outcomes.
one_line: Canadian Bioinformatics Workshops is a series of advanced bioinformatics training workshops founded in 1999 to build Canada's skilled workforce.
